description: This file defines the CalculatorProgrammerOperators class, a partial class for the calculator's programmer mode operators UI, including event handlers for radix selection and copy actions.

classes.name: CalculatorProgrammerOperators
classes.description: A sealed partial class representing the programmer mode operators UI in the calculator app.

methods.name: CalculatorProgrammerOperators
methods.description: Constructor initializing the component and setting the copy menu item text.

methods.name: Model
methods.description: Property returning the DataContext cast to StandardCalculatorViewModel.

methods.name: SymbolButtonStyle
methods.description: Property for getting and setting the style of symbol buttons.

methods.name: SetRadixButton
methods.description: Sets the appropriate radix button as checked based on the provided NumberBase.

methods.name: DecButtonChecked
methods.description: Event handler for when the decimal button is checked; switches calculator mode to decimal.

methods.name: HexButtonChecked
methods.description: Event handler for when the hexadecimal button is checked; switches calculator mode to hexadecimal.

methods.name: BinButtonChecked
methods.description: Event handler for when the binary button is checked; switches calculator mode to binary.

methods.name: OctButtonChecked
methods.description: Event handler for when the octal button is checked; switches calculator mode to octal.

methods.name: OnCopyMenuItemClicked
methods.description: Handles copy menu item click, copying the raw display value of the selected radix button to clipboard.
